questions.q: Which veteran actor plays the scientist Dr. Siddhant Arya, the villain of the first film?
questions.why: Naseeruddin Shah plays the evil scientist who builds the future-predicting supercomputer.

questions.q: What can Dr. Arya's supercomputer do?
questions.why: The machine shows future events, which is why Arya is obsessed with keeping it running.

questions.q: What does the supercomputer need from its comatose captive to keep working?
questions.why: Arya keeps Rohit comatose because the machine needs his heartbeat and retinal scans.

questions.q: Whom does Dr. Arya keep in a coma to feed his machine?
questions.why: Rohit, Krishna's father, is held comatose so Arya can use his body data.

questions.q: Which Singapore-based character does Arya kill in the film introducing him?
questions.why: Arya kills Kristian Li, which draws Krrish deeper into the fight.

questions.q: Where does the masked hero fatally injure Siddhant Arya?
questions.why: Their final confrontation takes place on a remote island.

questions.q: In which 2013 sequel does the veteran actor return as Dr. Arya in a special appearance?
questions.why: The Krrish 3 cast list credits Naseeruddin Shah as Dr. Siddhant Arya in a special appearance.

questions.q: Who plays Krishna's friend killed by Arya?
questions.why: Bin Xia plays Kristian Li in the 2006 film.

questions.q: Who directed the film introducing Siddhant Arya?
questions.why: Rakesh Roshan wrote, produced and directed the 2006 film.

questions.q: In which year did Siddhant Arya first appear on screen?
questions.why: Arya debuted in Krrish, released on 23 June 2006.
